description: Documentation Enhancement - Create missing documentation files in English and Turkish. Create CONTRIBUTING.md, CONTRIBUTING-tr.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, and enhance README structure with badges and API documentation.
steps: Create CONTRIBUTING.md in project root with comprehensive contribution guidelines covering: development setup, code style, commit conventions, PR process, testing requirements. Follow existing codebase patterns.
Create CONTRIBUTING-tr.md as full Turkish translation of CONTRIBUTING.md
Create SECURITY.md with security policy, supported versions, vulnerability reporting process
Create CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md based on Contributor Covenant with Turkish translation section
Move docs/CHANGELOG.md to project root as CHANGELOG.md (or create symlink)
Create docs/API.md documenting all REST API endpoints (GET /api/v1/analyze, GET /api/v1/methods, GET /api/v1/stats, GET /api/v1/diff, POST /api/v1/context, GET /api/v1/docs)
Create docs/API-tr.md as Turkish translation of API documentation
Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md documenting the plugin system, core modules, and data flow
Update README.md to add table of contents, improve badge section, add links to all new docs
Create README-tr.md in project root (move from docs/README-tr.md or create proper root-level translation)
acceptance_criteria: CONTRIBUTING.md exists with comprehensive contribution guidelines
CONTRIBUTING-tr.md exists as full Turkish translation
docs/API.md and docs/API-tr.md exist with all 6 API endpoints documented
README.md has improved structure with table of contents
verification: ls -la CONTRIBUTING.md CONTRIBUTING-tr.md SECURITY.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md CHANGELOG.md README-tr.md
npm run lint (ensure new markdown files are formatted)
